title: Optimizing Subroutines in Assembly Language
subtitle: An optimization guide for x86 platforms
author: Agner Fog
description: The second of Agner Fog's optimization manuals. Covers x86 assembly optimization in depth: ABI conventions, inline assembly, instruction scheduling, vector code with SSE/AVX, and building libraries compatible across compilers and platforms.
